webkit.method: Real Playwright keyboard.insertText plus public Monaco onDidChangeContent/model values
webkit.conclusion: History survives route changes. Test must not assume one whole-string insertion event across browsers. Final expected code unchanged.

firefox.finding: Monaco paints the visible editor separately from its zero-area internal textarea. Screenshot shows the full editor. Geometry assertions now wait for the editor container and rendered SELECT; keyboard-edit test remains separate.
firefox.keyboardFinding: Playwright Desktop Firefox descriptor supplies a Windows user-agent on this macOS runner. Monaco selects Ctrl bindings while ControlOrMeta sends Meta. Native browser projects remove this artificial mismatch; all four targeted Firefox/WebKit tests then passed.

webLocks.finding: Page close and WebKit lock release are asynchronous. A bounded expect.poll verifies eventual release without stealing a lock.
